messages:
john_custsuccess: FYI — Acme says objects with TTL=30d are still showing up in search after 31d. They've got default retention on convo transcripts and a custom 7d retention for embeddings, but it's the convo objects that are visible. Can you take a look?

amy_support: escalated to infra/security. @maria_enginfra @kevin_security can you triage? customer says they see deleted content via UI and search API. No immediate legal hold, but they're worried. :worried: 

maria_enginfra: checking logs now. quick question — do we have the object IDs or a sample query?

john_custsuccess: sample object id: obj_9a3f2b. Repro steps they provided: 
1) GET /v1/objects?org=acme&q=meeting returned obj_9a3f2b (visible)
2) GET /v1/objects/obj_9a3f2b returned tombstone: null, status: active
3) DELETE /v1/objects/obj_9a3f2b returned 202 accepted (delete queued)
4) 24h later still searchable.

amy_support: pasted raw API response they saved: 
```
{
  "id":"obj_9a3f2b",
  "created_at":"3124900000",
  "ttl_seconds":2592000,
  "tombstone":false,
  "metadata":{ "retention_policy":"default-30d" }
}
```

maria_enginfra: I see matching traces on the delete-scheduler for that org around 3124988000. Scheduler queued delete job id job_6678. But storage-side shows a KMS decrypt error on that job run: 
```
2024-11-22T12:13:40Z delete-worker job_6678 obj_9a3f2b -> kms.decrypt failed: KeyNotFoundError key=rnwrd-acme-2024-05 (code=403)
```

maria_enginfra: when the delete worker can't decrypt object metadata / keys, it marks job as retrying but we started accumulating backpressure. That matches the gap.

kevin_security: Confirming — we rotated a customer-managed key for acme on 3124999900 as part of scheduled roll. There were a handful of objects whose envelope keys weren't re-wrapped due to a failed background rewrap pass. Those objects remain readable by the app (cached index references) but deletion requires decrypt+verify. If decrypt fails, job stalls.

amy_support: so visible in search because index still has the entry, but storage-level tombstone hasn't been applied?

maria_enginfra: exactly. Our indexer is eventually consistent and we rely on tombstone writes to trigger index eviction. If tombstone write fails due to KMS, the index entry persists until re-index or manual purge.

john_custsuccess: customer asked for timeline and workaround, they want a manual purge option.

maria_enginfra: immediate mitigations: 
- We can run an emergency rewrap for that customer's envelope keys (one-off) — requires key access and will re-encrypt the object metadata so delete-worker can complete.
- Alternatively, run an index purge for object IDs (force-remove from search index) to hide them from search while we fix deletes.

kevin_security: rewrap requires HSM operator approval. I can approve today but need a signed request and audit export attached. Also need to rotate back to previous key if anything goes wrong.

amy_support: proposed action list to customer: 
1) Submit signed approval (we'll provide template).
2) We perform emergency rewrap + re-run delete-queue for IDs. 
3) If needed, index purge to hide results within 2h. 
4) We'll run a backfill job to scan 30d+ TTL objects and reconcile tombstones (24–72h window).

john_custsuccess: they accepted steps 1–3. Asked if this impacts billing or exports.

maria_enginfra: no billing change. For exports: we'll export audit events for all relevant object_ids and key events (KMS rotate, rewrap). I'll attach the audit log snippet.

deploy-bot: retention-backfill started job=rb_2024_3125 target=org:acme scan_from=3122600000

amy_support: IMPORTANT — repro steps for eng to verify locally: 
- curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/objects/obj_9a3f2b" 
- check logs on delete-worker: `kubectl logs -l app=delete-worker -n org-acme --since=48h | grep obj_9a3f2b`
- check kms errors: `kubectl logs -l app=kms-proxy -n infra --since=48h | grep KeyNotFoundError`

maria_enginfra: doing rewrap now (manual). I'll update once completed. ETA ~90m for HSM ops + verification.

kevin_security: I'll prep the signed approval template and audit export. Also recommend we add a monitoring alert: delete-worker KMS error rate > 0.5% for an org -> page oncall.

amy_support: thanks — I'll keep customer updated. Assigned support ticket #S-12291 and legal notified to confirm no hold.

john_custsuccess: Customer confirmed they no longer see those objects in the UI after we purged index entries. Wants confirmation when the tombstone is actually applied in storage.

maria_enginfra: rewrap complete, delete-queue rerun succeeded for job_6678, tombstone write returned 200 at 3125000305. Storage now shows tombstone:true for obj_9a3f2b. Backfill job continuing.

amy_support: closing loop with customer: will send audit export and timeline. Marking as resolved in slack thread; keeping ticket open until backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
